The logic is in `src/lib/credential-delivery.ts`:

- **`isValidActivationUrl(url)`** (line 13) checks that a string is a valid absolute http(s) URL. A value like `"TIGER"` is never treated as a link.
- **Kind detection** (around lines 38–43) returns `"activation_link"` when `accountUrl` or `rawPayload` passes that check. The other `DeliveryKind` values are `"account"`, `"access_text"` and `"missing"`.
- **`getUnitCopyValue(cred, kind)`** (line 76) builds the clipboard text. For activation links it returns the trimmed `accountUrl`, or `rawPayload` if that is the valid URL. I only read the activation-link case, so check the function itself for how the other kinds are copied.

I didn't look at where these functions are called. The other hits in `src/services/receipt.service.ts` and `src/services/telegram-notification.service.ts` may use them.
